name: branding-blobby-bold-italic-benchmark-wordmark
title: Puffy bold-italic BENCH MARK wordmark with a wide-tracked subline
whatItIs: A white slide with tiny caps corner labels and a black stacked wordmark 'BENCH MARK' in fat slanted rounded letters with small counters, above 'STRENGTH CLUB' in wide tracked caps.
whatItMeans: Heavy, friendly and energetic; the puffy italics feel like lifted weight.
techniques: Use inflated slanted letters with tiny counters.
Contrast with a wide-tracked caps descriptor.

vocabulary.definition: Letters that look puffed with air.
Lines set with almost no leading.
Widely spaced small caps under a logo.
